relevance_note: Case report of a girl with a clinical diagnosis of arterial tortuosity syndrome ("supports the clinical diagnosis of ATS"), plus a literature table of repaired pulmonary artery stenosis in ATS; no SLC2A10 variant is reported for anyone.
method_note: Read the whole paper manually; output assembled with a short Python script and every span checked verbatim by script. Index patient labelled 'patient' (single unnamed case-report patient); diagnosis is clinical only, no genetic testing or SLC2A10 variant is reported, so the variants table is empty. Age at diagnosis 'as a newborn' taken from the abstract ('diagnosed with ATS affecting the pulmonary arteries as a newborn'); the case presentation says she was diagnosed with PAS as a newborn and the clinical ATS diagnosis is not dated. Paternal male cousin (3 years) is an affected relative ('similarly affected', 'tortuous great vessels requiring balloon dilatation'); no ATS diagnosis is stated for him, so disease label is not reported; 'great vessels' is not specific to aorta or other arteries, so both tortuosity checklist items are left not reported for him. Table 1 (literature) rows 1 (Santoro 2008) and 2 (Ricciardi 2020) are single previously published patients with an individual age, so they get rows labelled 'Table 1 row <k>' with source_reference_in_review; the table 'Age' column is recorded as age at last evaluation (it is not defined as onset or diagnosis). Row 3 (Alkhaldi 2022, 33 patients, median age) is group-level only and gets no rows. Pulmonary artery stenosis for the Table 1 patients relies on the table title ('Repaired pulmonary artery stenosis cases in patients with arterial tortuosity syndrome'). 'No' in the Lung reperfusion injury column was read as an explicit absence (a word, not a symbol). For the index patient, 'absence of any focal stenosis' of the aorta excludes only aortic focal stenosis; the broader checklist item 'stenosis of the aorta or aortic branches' is left not reported. Right ventricular hypertension/suprasystemic RV pressure was not mapped to pulmonary hypertension or ventricular hypertrophy. Vital status left not reported (not stated, although follow-up at 2 months is described). cites_prior_report_of_same_patients left null: the paper does not say its own case was published before. Discussion mentions of earlier reports (Ertugrul, Beuren) give no individual-level facts and get no rows. No contradictions found.
